subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support add `channels.signal.linkPreview`, call signal-cli `updateConfiguration`, and pass explicit preview fields, and what default plus per-account semantics should it use?
rationale: The missing implementation is clear, but the default behavior, linked-device failure mode, container-mode scope, and untrusted metadata boundary are product/security choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Default-safe explicit support
options.body: Add a Signal plugin setting that preserves existing behavior for unset configs, passes only caller-provided preview fields, documents primary-device limits, and keeps metadata fetching out of scope.

options.title: Defer behind security design
options.body: Keep this open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/22060 settles the external-preview metadata boundary, then implement the Signal config with that policy.

options.title: Enable previews by default
options.body: Turn Signal previews on by default with an escape hatch, accepting the higher upgrade, linked-device, and security review burden.

recommendation.title: Default-safe explicit support
recommendation.body: Add a Signal plugin setting that preserves existing behavior for unset configs, passes only caller-provided preview fields, documents primary-device limits, and keeps metadata fetching out of scope.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Signal send/config/docs history in the sampled evidence and already provided public context on the issue.
